input.about: Starts the workflow with the value you give it when you run it: a test case, a sample, or what someone types in Conversation.
tips: Change the output type to Object to receive JSON instead of text.
A workflow can have several inputs; each one becomes a field in the run form.

ports.out.text: The value supplied when the run starts.

dataset-rows.about: Supplies a list of records, either typed in as JSON rows or taken from a dataset you saved in Training.
tips: Set the row type on the Rows port so later steps know each record's fields.
Large datasets are read when the run starts, not when you save.

ports.out.rows: Every row, as a JSON array.

pass.about: Forwards its input unchanged. Useful as a named junction while you rearrange a graph.
tips: The output always has the same type as the input.

parse-json.about: Reads text as JSON and checks the result against the output type, so later steps get structured data.
tips: Put it after a Model that answers in JSON text.
The step fails with the reason when the text is not valid JSON.

field.about: Returns one named field from an object.
tips: Set the field name in the inspector.
Choose the output type that matches the field's value.

first.about: Returns the first value in an array.
tips: Sort or filter the rows first when order matters.

count.about: Counts the values in an array.
tips: Combine with Filter rows to count only matching records.

format.about: Turns any value into text. Objects and arrays become formatted JSON.
tips: Use Fill a text template when you need your own wording around the value.

output.about: Marks a value as a result of the workflow. Runs, Conversation and Run history show it.
tips: A workflow can return several outputs.
Its type follows the wire you connect.

approval.about: Pauses the run and asks a person to approve an action before anything happens. The decision is recorded on the run.
tips: Denied or expired requests stop the run at this step.

generate.about: Sends its inputs to a local Transformers checkpoint and returns the answer as typed JSON or plain text.
tips: Choose the checkpoint in the inspector; the node warns until one is set.
Plain text needs a single text output.
Connect an Attach trained LoRA node to specialise the model.

reason.about: Uses a checkpoint that can think before answering. Only the final answer leaves the node.
tips: Pick a checkpoint marked as supporting explicit thinking.
Give it a larger output budget than a plain Model node.

lora.about: Loads adapter weights you trained and plugs them into a Model or Reasoning node.
tips: The adapter must match the checkpoint it connects to.

ports.out.adapter: Connect to a model's LoRA adapter input.

constant.about: Supplies a fixed value, such as a label, a threshold or a default setting.
tips: Write the value as JSON: quotes for text, plain digits for numbers.

build-object.about: Combines connected values into one JSON object. Each input key becomes a field name.
tips: Add an input port for every field you need.

ports.in.field: A value to include under this key.

template.about: Writes text from a template, filling in {key} with the value on the matching input.
tips: Write {{ and }} for literal braces.
Each {key} needs an input port with that key.

compare.about: Compares two values and returns true or false.
tips: Ordering compares numbers; Contains looks inside text or an array.
Feed the result into Choose a value.

choose.about: Returns one of two values depending on a true or false condition.
tips: Both values are computed before the choice is made.

ports.in.if_true: Returned when the condition is true.

validate.about: Checks a value against rules. A mismatch fails the step with the field path, and later steps are skipped.

example.output: Fails: id must not be empty

tips: The rules are a small JSON Schema subset.
Put it before steps that must not see bad data.

ports.out.value: The same value, once it passes.

filter.about: Keeps the rows whose field passes a rule, such as amount >= 100.
tips: Rows without the field are left out.

sort.about: Orders rows by one field. Add desc for largest first.
tips: Rows without the field go last.

search.about: Finds passages in your Knowledge documents that match a query.
tips: Connect Context to a Model prompt.
Use Results when you need scores and sources.

ports.out.context: The passages as one block of text.
